actors.observation_scope: Sees signer-approved display data and verifies complete authorization evidence before authority is issued.
Sees public terms and only disclosures approved for the counterparty.
Sees resolution inputs allowed by disclosure policy but receives no signing authority.
Sees public inputs and committed witness material needed by the named proof relation.
Sees submitted runtime events and authorized disclosures without upgrading service observations to semantics.
Sees immutable signing bytes, policy context, and complete authorization verification results.
Sees ledger-public events at explicitly named settlement levels.
Sees retained public evidence and approved audit disclosures, with unavailable evidence marked explicitly.

event_fields.definition: Transport or ledger interface through which the event was observed.
event_fields.visibility_rule: channel is displayed only to actors permitted by its signed disclosure classification; authorization evaluation still accounts for its effects.
event_fields.declassification_rule: Declassifying channel changes only which permitted actors can view it and never authorizes effects or capabilities.

display_projection.name: DisplayProjection
display_projection.purpose: Select actor-visible data under visibility and approved-disclosure rules.
display_projection.authority_rule: DisplayProjection is presentation data and never establishes authorization.

authorization_projection.name: AuthorizationProjection
authorization_projection.purpose: Account for every public, private, fee, refund, change, and failed-path effect through complete inclusion and exclusion evidence.
authorization_projection.authority_rule: authorizedAt evaluates every hard predicate only over this projection bound to trace, outcome, domain, level, signed intent, and predicate set.

declassification_rule: Declassification changes visibility only; it never adds an allowed effect, expands a capability, or converts unavailable evidence to valid.

signing_profiles.name: SignAfterResolve
signing_profiles.authorization_boundary: Before signing a concrete resolved plan, with freshness revalidation at execution when required.

signing_profiles.name: SignBeforeResolve
signing_profiles.authorization_boundary: At execution before assets or authority are consumed by the named enforcement mechanism.
requirements: domain, nonce, validity, cancellation, signers, capabilities, and disclosures

limitations: The local Python transfer checker compares supplied transfers only and does not authenticate projection completeness.
Neither signing-order profile is implemented or proved in S01.
